Package com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim

Class VisionSimWorld

java.lang.Object
com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim.VisionSimWorld
public final class VisionSimWorld extends Object
A registry of shared simulated worlds.

A VisionSystemSim represents a field with its AprilTags and every camera looking at it. Several SimulatedLimelight instances declaring the same world name share a single instance, which is what multi-camera setups need: the tags load once and the robot pose propagates to every camera at once.

Updates are deduplicated within one cycle, so it makes no difference whether you call SimulatedLimelight.periodic(Pose2d) on each camera or updateAll(Pose2d) once: the world advances once per cycle.

  • Method Details

    • get

      public static VisionSimWorld get(String name, edu.wpi.first.apriltag.AprilTagFieldLayout layout)
      Returns the world with that name, creating it with the given layout the first time.

      If the world already existed the layout is ignored: whoever asked first defines it. That keeps two cameras with different configurations from trampling each other's tags.

      Parameters:
      name - world identifier.
      layout - the AprilTag layout to load if it has to be created.
      Returns:
      the shared world.

    • updateAll

      public static void updateAll(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose2d robotPose)

      Parameters:
      robotPose - the robot's current simulated pose.
